checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.body: We sent a verification link to {email} if it isn't registered yet. Click it to activate your account, or sign in if you already have one.

resend.sent: If this account needs verification, we sent a new link to your email.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.description: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to reset it
forgot.sentBody: If an account exists for {email}, we sent a link to reset your password.

reset.title: Reset your password
reset.description: Choose a new password for your account
reset.success: Password updated. You can now sign in.

verify.title: Confirm your email
verify.description: Enter your account password to finish verification
verify.success: Email verified. You can now sign in.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.description: Enter your current password to set a new one.
changePassword.success: Password updated. Please sign in again.
